processing: Original stereo synthesis 44.1kHz; Vorbis q5; measured approximately -22 LUFS and <=-2 dBTP; no borrowed melodies or recordings
music_assignment: original-cas-score-v1; set_scene resolves harbor local daytime/nighttime; original user MP4 tracks retained as inactive legacy metadata only
local_voice_policy: Only seat-visible live events; no hidden contacts. Direction from seat-visible coordinates only. No clip when a direction is unknown.
release_gate: Exclude local_music and local_voice for public builds unless clearance is recorded. UI sounds CC0 may ship.

uncertainties.issue: The archive has no dedicated "torpedo hit" attacker line. "Enemy severely damaged" is used; it is true for a damaging torpedo hit but not torpedo-specific.
uncertainties.mitigation: Fallback order still works; the ledger marks match="semantic".

uncertainties.issue: No Japanese attacker-side torpedo-hit line was found. Japanese "击穿" lines are gunnery/armour-penetration reports and would be false for a torpedo hit.
uncertainties.mitigation: Left unbound. With pack=auto the axis torpedo_hit cue stays silent; with an explicit commander pack the commander torpedo_hit file is used.

uncertainties.issue: No generic Japanese "taking fire / hit" line. The archive only has system-specific damage lines (turret, engine, rudder, fire, flooding).
uncertainties.mitigation: Only the torpedo damage line (中雷 -> JP0122) is bound. Generic gun damage falls back to the original wows-jp damage m4a.

uncertainties.issue: Japanese "击穿目标了" is a penetration report, not a plain hit acknowledgement.
uncertainties.mitigation: Marked match="semantic"; it is only used for the attacker-side hit cue.

uncertainties.issue: All archive warnings are directional; the kernel event text does not carry a bearing.
uncertainties.mitigation: BattleVoice derives the bearing from the seat-visible event x/y and the nearest own ship. If the event has no coordinate or no own ship, it falls back to the original generic m4a instead of guessing a direction.

uncertainties.issue: The kernel writes system criticals as kind=critical and does not attach a voiceCue to turret/flood/damage-control events; only the fire critical carries the fire cue.
uncertainties.mitigation: BattleVoice.derivedCue maps 主炮座/主炮塔/主炮弹药库, 进水/水线/堵漏 and 损管/灭火/消防 critical text to a damage cue. This is a client-side dispatch derivation only; it changes neither the kernel event nor its text.

uncertainties.issue: US0104 is "主炮塔严重受损", but the kernel also emits 主炮座 N 失效 (a disabled mount) and 主炮弹药库爆炸 (magazine explosion followed by own_sunk). US0105 "主炮塔被炸毁" would overstate the disabled-mount case and has no Japanese counterpart.
uncertainties.mitigation: The turret variant uses US0104/JP0125 and is marked match="semantic"; US0105 stays unbound. The magazine-explosion event also ends in the own_sunk blocker, so no destruction line is claimed here.

uncertainties.issue: The archive has one cruiser sighting line per language, not separate CA/CL/CB lines; BC has no separate line either.
uncertainties.mitigation: CL/CA/CB share the registered cl variant and BC shares bb. The variant is chosen from the nearest seat-visible contact kind; unknown kinds keep the generic contact clip.

uncertainties.issue: JP0121 title_zh is 警告！船上发生火灾, but the ASR reads 戦場に火災 (fire on the battlefield) and the clip is flagged asr_ocr_difference.
uncertainties.mitigation: It is the only Japanese onboard-fire line and is used only when a victim-side fire event (起火/火灾) is present; never for an open-fire cue. Flag kept in the asset record.

uncertainties.issue: The engine cue means an own torpedo hit an allied ship. US0127 "Don't fire at your allies" is a warning, not a damage report; US0128 adds a disciplinary penalty CAS does not impose.
uncertainties.mitigation: US0127 is bound and marked match="semantic"; no sunk/destroyed claim is played.

uncertainties.issue: No Japanese TTS voice is installed on this machine (only zh-CN Huihui and en-US Zira). The axis synthetic fire-control UI line is therefore Chinese, unlike the Japanese archive crew.
uncertainties.mitigation: Tagged kind=synthetic_ui and kept in synthetic_assets, never in the archive list. Replace only damage-control-fire-zh.wav if a Japanese voice becomes available.

uncertainties.issue: The kernel has no fire-extinguished event. It only reports a signed 火灾损管 severity change. A negative value proves the fire casualty was reduced, not that it reached zero.
uncertainties.mitigation: The synthetic line says fire under control, not extinguished, and plays only for a negative 火灾损管 severity. Positive or zero control messages stay on the generic fallback; no archive fire line is misused.

uncertainties.issue: Only one exact Japanese exposure line (JP0230 舰长，本舰被发现了) exists; the allies have two (US0202/US0182).
uncertainties.mitigation: Axis exposure is deterministic; allies select randomly between the two exact lines. Contact lines are not used as a substitute.

uncertainties.issue: The archive has exactly one on and one off autopilot line per side, so random selection cannot apply.
uncertainties.mitigation: The exact line for the seat and state is used; no unrelated movement line is substituted.

uncertainties.issue: The score cue is derived in the client from seat-visible own_sunk/enemy_sunk events; it is not a kernel voiceCue and the threshold is a client rule, not a CAS table value.
uncertainties.mitigation: Only visible events are counted (never hidden HP), the gap must reach two ships, and a 60 s cooldown plus the 12 s cue cooldown prevent spam. Losing uses US0159/JP0194; winning uses US0093/US0094/US0095/US0219/US0221 and JP0098/JP0100.

uncertainties.issue: The cue is triggered only by the player command path in main.tsx, not by the kernel gun event, because AI gun fire also emits kernel gun events.
uncertainties.mitigation: AI auto fire stays silent for manual_fire; the kernel fire cue still maps gun/torpedo launches to the original wows fire m4a.

uncertainties.issue: The archive has no exact 损管/灭火/火灭/消火 line. The closest generic candidates are US0110 问题解决，长官 and JP0133 应对措施已完成，but neither is fire/flood-control specific.
uncertainties.mitigation: No exact control clip is copied. The successful fire-control case uses a synthetic UI line; control-flood aliases to the closest registered flood clip. Both are approximate and marked in blockers, never presented as an exact damage-control recording.
